tools.name: validate
tools.description: Check SysML v2 text (or KerML, with language "kerml") against the MBEstudio profile: syntax, name resolution, typing, units, and evaluation errors. Call it after every change. Output: { valid, errors, roots, diagnostics: [{ severity, code, message, line, column, hint }] }.

tools.name: outline
tools.description: The declarations of a model as a tree: packages, definitions, usages, requirements, states, each with its kind, qualified name, short name (id) and line. Use it to find what to edit.

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Elaborate the system and evaluate it: every requirement with its verdict (satisfied, violated, indeterminate), value, limit and margin; constraint verdicts; analysis findings (budgets, clashes, interfaces, safety); and every attribute value with its source (stated, computed, default). tools.name: query
tools.description: One element of the model. An instance path (airliner.leftEngine) returns its size and position, children, values, ports, connections and the requirements it satisfies; a qualified name (MidsizeAircraft::Engine) or simple name returns its declaration outline.

tools.name: trace_gaps

tools.description: Run the model's state machines over time (timers, change triggers, scenario events) and judge the requirements and constraints over the run. Output: machines, the trace of fired transitions, and verdicts over time.

tools.name: examples
tools.description: Without name: the example models that ship with MBEstudio. With name: that model's full SysML text, a good starting point and a reference for the profile's metadata (@Envelope, @Placement, @Material, @Budget, @Safety).

tools.name: odd_catalog
tools.description: List lightweight scenario manifests for every bundled demo and administrator-configured external MCP simulation providers. Asset references remain external; the server does not download datasets.

tools.name: odd_prepare
tools.description: Bind a scenario to the exact model SHA-256 and export placed geometry and sensor metadata for an external simulator adapter. Large OpenUSD, OpenSCENARIO or dataset assets remain URI references. Does not start a remote run.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "query" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "edit" is 2434 chars, far longer than this server's median (371). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate, trace_gaps, edit · Private data: ontology_sync, ontology_discover, export, import, fit_mesh · Public sink: ontology_sync, ontology_discover · Destructive: edit, ontology_sync, simulate, export, import, odd_prepare.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate, trace_gaps, edit · Private data: ontology_sync, ontology_discover, export, import, fit_mesh · Public sink: ontology_sync, ontology_discover · Destructive: edit, ontology_sync, simulate, export, import, odd_prepare

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
